visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A female character with large, dark-lashed eyes and light makeup looks directly at the camera. A rectangular patch of beige cushion foundation is applied to her right cheek, creating a sharp contrast with her natural skin tone. She is wearing a vibrant red top with a choker-style collar. (2) The scene cuts to an arm with a noticeable dark bruise or birthmark. A beige cushion puff with the brand name 'SKINTIFIC' is pressed firmly onto the mark. The camera zooms in as the foundation completely conceals the mark, leaving a smooth, even-toned surface. (3) A split-screen comparison shows the character's face. The left side is labeled with circles indicating 'spots' and 'dullness' around her eye and nose. The right side shows a 'perfectly flawless' finish. She smiles subtly, her lips glossy and red. (4) The character stands in front of a 'Watsons' retail store, waving to the camera. She wears a white cardigan over her red top and carries a silver handbag. The background shows the brightly lit storefront and other passers-by in a shopping mall hallway. (5) Close-up of store shelves packed with blue 'SKINTIFIC' skincare boxes. A blue jar of '5X CERAMIDE Barrier Moisture Gel' is prominently featured in the foreground. The lighting is bright and industrial, typical of a retail environment. (6) The character is seen indoors, wearing pink sequined mouse ears. She holds a circular, gold-colored cushion foundation compact. The light reflects off the shiny, mirrored surface of the compact, which features the 'SKINTIFIC' logo in bold lettering. (7) Detailed shots of the compact's interior reveal a fine-mesh sponge soaked in beige foundation. A teardrop-shaped puff is used to pick up the product. The character is then seen applying the product to her face in an airplane cabin or similar transport setting. (8) A graphic appears showing seven different foundation shades applied as streaks on an arm, each labeled with a number and name like 'Vanilla' or 'Ivory'. A flowchart then displays skin tone categories to help viewers choose their correct match. (9) A montage shows the character in various locations, including an outdoor park and a dimly lit indoor space, showing her makeup's durability. Timestamps like '4hr' and '8hr' appear on the screen as she points to her skin. (10) The character stands outdoors near a Disney-themed gate, smiling and holding the gold compact near her chin. She wears the same red top and sequined ears, looking confident and cheerful under natural daylight.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The video transitions between several settings: a bright, minimalist indoor room; a Watsons retail store with shelves full of skincare products; the interior of a train or airplane cabin with passenger seats; and an outdoor theme park area resembling Disneyland with colorful gates and crowds.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-energy female voice narrating in Mandarin over an upbeat, synthetic pop BGM with a strong, four-on-the-floor beat. Digital UI 'click' sound effects accompany the appearance of on-screen text as she enthusiastically describes the product's effectiveness. (2) As the scene transitions to the retail store, a subtle 'whoosh' sound effect is heard. The BGM remains consistent, maintaining a steady tempo around 120 BPM. The speaker's pitch rises with excitement when mentioning the 'hot' status of the brand in Malaysia. (3) During the product demonstration phases, sharp 'pop' and 'ding' SFX highlight key feature points. The background music remains prominent but stays clearly behind the primary narration, which is clear and professionally recorded with no audible ambient interference. (4) In the outdoor Disney sequences, a very faint background crowd murmur is audible during speech pauses, but the mastering engineer has kept the signal-to-noise ratio high. The BGM continues through the 4-hour and 8-hour check-ins, punctuating the time shifts with rhythmic consistency. (5) The final phase features a call-to-action with the speaker's voice maintaining high arousal and positive valence. A final UI 'ping' sounds as the video ends, with the BGM fading out quickly after the last spoken word.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Problem -> Product Introduction -> Technical Features -> Demonstration -> Proof/Testing -> Conclusion -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a comprehensive promotional review and tutorial for the Skintific cushion foundation. It aims to prove the product's superior coverage (by showing it hide birthmarks), long-wear capabilities (through an 8-hour wear test), and ease of use, ultimately encouraging viewers to purchase it via Watsons or a provided link.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct product demonstration, verbal praise of brand efficacy, shelf display in a major retailer (Watsons), and a call to action for a discount link.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video utilizes a high density of visual and auditory markers characteristic of social media influencer marketing. The fast editing pace and constant use of variety-show style text overlays maintain high engagement throughout the review.
